grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTPREVENT, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, CAB.CODVEND, (SELECT V.APELIDO FROM TGFVEN V WHERE V.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND) AS VEDEDOR, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, ITE.QTDNEG, NVL((SELECT SUM(NVL(EST.ESTOQUE,0)) AS ESTOQUEATUAL FROM TGFEST EST WHERE EST.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD),0) AS ESTOQUEATUAL, NVL((SELECT SUM(NVL(EST.ESTOQUE,0)) AS ESTOQUEATUAL FROM TGFEST EST WHERE EST.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD),0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(IPA.QTDPRODUZIR) - SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(I.QTDNEG) FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON (C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA) WHERE C.TIPMOV= 'F' AND C.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND I.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 AND I.CODPROD = IPA.CODPRODPA),0)) FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (PROC.IDIPROC = IPA.IDIPROC) WHERE PROC.STATUSPROC IN ('A','P2') AND IPA.CODPRODPA = ITE.CODPROD AND NVL(PROC.DTPREVENT,TRUNC(PROC.DHINC)+ 7) <= :P_SIMULACRO),0) SIMULACRO, NVL((SELECT SUM(NVL(EST.ESTOQUE,0)) AS ESTOQUEATUAL FROM TGFEST EST WHERE EST.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD),0) + NVL((SELECT SUM(IPA.QTDPRODUZIR) - SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(I.QTDNEG) FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON (C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA) WHERE C.TIPMOV= 'F' AND C.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND I.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 AND I.CODPROD = IPA.CODPRODPA),0)) FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (PROC.IDIPROC = IPA.IDIPROC) WHERE PROC.STATUSPROC IN ('A','P2') AND IPA.CODPRODPA = ITE.CODPROD AND NVL(PROC.DTPREVENT,TRUNC(PROC.DHINC)+ 7) <= CAB.DTPREVENT),0) SIMULACAO FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON (ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND CAB.CODTIPOPER <> 900) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND PRO.USOPROD='V' AND PRO.ATIVO='S' AND PRO.AD_OBSOLETO = 'N') INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC --LEFT JOIN TGFEST EST ON (PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD AND EST.CODLOCAL = 109) WHERE (TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN) AND ITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND (:P_ENTREGA IS NULL OR (TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) >= :P_ENTREGA.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) <= :P_ENTREGA.FIN)) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) ORDER BY CAB.CODPARC, CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.CODPROD
